snippet.title: Art Attack Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Art Attack is an action roguelike with a unique paint based combat system, and a distaste for GenAI, Currently in development by Solidplasma and his team.

Wishlist now on steam to be the first to try the free playtest! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238010/Art_Attack/

Catch development live on Twitch! http://twitch.tv/solidplasma
Join my community on Discord! https://discord.gg/MnmV4wGFzh
